turns.text: I remember that you that you were saying uh that um at some point you even decided that you want to switch the companies because, you know, you've been working with one of the biggest, we're not going to name the company, but one of the biggest and most recognizable brands in uh Dubai.

Well, I understood that it's it doesn't matter which company you work with actually. It matters how you work, how you operate, what is your mindset. Because whenever you change a company, you will still end up in the environment where everybody is focusing on themselves. And they have their own problems, they have their own highs and lows and success and everything. And nobody has time to focus on you, you know, you are on your own. It's the sphere where you don't have salary, you have to climb the mountain yourself. So yeah, at some point I wanted to change the company, but then I was like, let me just give myself a second chance with this company, but this time, when I thought I will give myself a second chance, this time I'll focus on my skills. Not focus on what the company is providing you, but focus on how I can become better and what I'm lacking and what should be improved.
